def T(n):return n^((n<<1)|(n<<2))
def G(n,g):return T(n)^(g!='t')^(2 if g=='p' and n%2==0 else 0)
def inv(x,g):
    assert x>=0
    n=x.bit_length()+8
    v=0
    for i in range(n):
        if (G(v,g)^x)&(1<<i):v|=1<<i
    if v>>(n-2)==3:v-=1<<n
    else:assert v>>(n-2)==0
    assert G(v,g)==x
    return v

def B(x,q):
    a=inv(x,q)
    assert a>=0
    b=inv(a,'p')
    z=4*b+3
    assert z%16=={'t':11,'u':7}[q]
    assert G(G(z>>2,'p'),q)==x
    return {'a':a,'b':b,'B':z,'cls':'POS' if b>=0 else 'NEG'}
assert B(27,'u')['B']==7

# Independent transfer uses forward packed triangular matching with artificial
# initial low two bits. It does not import Muse's inverse recurrence.
def transfer(H,s,extra=0):
    w=H.bit_length()
    a=((s>>3)&1)*2+((s>>2)&1)
    b=((s>>1)&1)*2+(s&1)
    target=H<<2
    for i in range(2,w+2+extra):
        if (T(a)^target)&(1<<i):a|=1<<i
        if (T(b)^a)&(1<<i):b|=1<<i
    end=w+extra
    return ((a>>end)&3)*4+((b>>end)&3)

    return ((a>>(l-2))&3)*4+((b>>(l-2))&3)

def pair_update(pair,bit):return (bit<<1)|(pair>>1)
def bit_inverse(pair,desired):return ((T(pair)>>2)&1)^desired
def product(s,vi):
    vp,at,bt,au,bu=s
    xi=(T(vp|(vi<<2))>>2)&1
    ati=bit_inverse(at,xi);aui=bit_inverse(au,xi)
    bti=bit_inverse(bt,ati);bui=bit_inverse(bu,aui)
    return tuple(pair_update(p,b) for p,b in zip(s,(vi,ati,bti,aui,bui)))

import functools
membership_nodes={}
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def member_u(v,k):
    key=f'{k}:{v}'
    if k<1 or v<=0 or v.bit_length()!=2*k-1:
        membership_nodes[key]={'accepted':False,'reason':'sign-or-width'};return None
    if k==1:
        ok=v==1;membership_nodes[key]={'accepted':ok,'reason':'root'}
        return 'u' if ok else None
    parents=[];word=None
    for g in 'tup':
        parent=inv(v,g);pw=member_u(parent,k-1)
        parents.append([g,parent,pw is not None])
        if pw is not None and word is None:word=pw+g
    membership_nodes[key]={'accepted':word is not None,'parents':parents}
    return word
